title: 1권 4유닛 장면 · 4
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: The garden wall with a small round wooden door. Hedgie turns the golden key in the golden padlock and the door swings open, showing a dark blue starry night garden on the other side. Bun is already jumping through the doorway with one boot in the air; Pip flutters after her. Three new letter trees (J with jelly, juice and jump fruits; K with key, kite and koala fruits; L with lemon, leg and lock fruits) stand behind them. Grumble pops out of a dirt hole right beside the door; his finger-over-lips sign lies flat on the ground like a doormat and he is staring at the open door with his mouth open; his lantern glows warm and bright. Hidden in the picture: the padlock, the golden key in Hedgie's paw. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
